raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
CVE-2026-114145 affects GitPython 3.2.0 on the `r0.7.0` source scan. An attacker-controlled submodule path can place a Git hook before the path is rejected; a later Git operation can execute it.

Require GitPython >=3.2.1 in both the Bridge dependency override and the Framework image's system-Python install. Regenerate `uv.lock` from 3.2.0 to 3.2.1. The existing upper bound `<4` remains.

Validation: `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` in the project container, `uv run --no-sync pre-commit run --all-files`, and `git diff --check`. CI and a rebuilt image scan remain pending.

detail.title: build(security): require GitPython 3.2.1 on r0.7.0

files.patch:
@@ -116,7 +116,7 @@ RUN pip install "fastapi==0.139.1" \
     "jupyterlab>=4.5.10" \
     "jupyter-server>=2.20.0" \
     "mistune>=3.3.0" \
-    "GitPython>=3.1.62,<4" && \
+    "GitPython>=3.2.1,<4" && \
     # pip targets system Python; explicitly remove the virtualenv copy too.
     uv pip uninstall --python /opt/venv/bin/python opencv-python-headless && \
     uv pip uninstall --python /usr/bin/python3 --system --break-system-packages \

@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@ overrides = [
     { name = "cryptography", specifier = ">=50.0.0,<51" },
     { name = "fast-hadamard-transform", git = "https://github.com/Dao-AILab/fast-hadamard-transform.git?rev=v1.1.0" },
     { name = "fastapi", specifier = "<0.139.2" },
-    { name = "gitpython", specifier = ">=3.1.62,<4" },
+    { name = "gitpython", specifier = ">=3.2.1,<4" },
     { name = "imageio", marker = "sys_platform == 'never'" },
     { name = "imageio-ffmpeg", marker = "sys_platform == 'never'" },
     { name = "langchain", specifier = ">=0.3.28" },
